headline: Gold Slides Toward $4,090 as Mideast Tensions Fuel Inflation Fears
summary: Gold prices slid toward $4,090 per ounce as escalating Middle East tensions stoked broader concerns over inflation and monetary policy responses.
why: Gold is widely traded as a traditional safe-haven asset and a primary hedge against geopolitical instability and inflationary pressures.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Strengthening broader dollar liquidity and shifting real yield expectations can cause temporary pullbacks in precious metals despite safe-haven narratives.

why_moved: Shifting macroeconomic expectations and dollar positioning led to profit-taking in precious metals despite ongoing regional security risks.
